# MasterTools - Complete Documentation for AI Agents

> MasterTools (https://masterperi5.me) is a privacy-first web utility suite providing free online calculators, academic converters, developer tools, and productivity utilities.

## Overview

All tools run 100% in the user's browser (client-side execution). No personal data or calculation inputs are stored on any server.

---

## Catalog of Available Tools

### 1. CGPA Calculator
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/cgpa-calculator
- **Description**: Computes Cumulative Grade Point Average (CGPA) from individual semester grades/GPA and credit weights using standard 10-point scale formulas.
- **Use Cases**: College students calculating current CGPA, targeted GPA needed in upcoming semesters.

### 2. Percentage Calculator
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/percentage-calculator
- **Description**: Calculates percentage score from obtained vs total marks, percentage change (increase/decrease), and fraction ratios.
- **Use Cases**: Student exam results, discount calculations, test scoring.

### 3. Attendance Calculator
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/attendance-calculator
- **Description**: Analyzes current lecture attendance vs required threshold (e.g., 75% or 80%). Calculates exact number of consecutive classes needed to attend or maximum classes safe to miss.
- **Use Cases**: College and school students maintaining mandatory attendance cutoffs.

### 4. Age Calculator
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/age-calculator
- **Description**: Calculates exact chronological age given date of birth. Returns age breakdown in years, months, days, total hours/minutes lived, and next birthday countdown.
- **Use Cases**: Official form filling, birthday tracking, age verification.

### 5. JSON Formatter & Validator
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/json-formatter
- **Description**: Client-side JSON formatting tool with indentation control (2 spaces, 4 spaces, tab), minification, validity checking, and precise line-by-line syntax error identification.
- **Use Cases**: Developers formatting API payloads, validating raw JSON snippets without risking data exposure.

### 6. Word & Character Counter
- **URL**: https://masterperi5.me/tools/word-counter
- **Description**: Analyzes input text in real time. Provides word count, character count (with and without spaces), sentence count, paragraph count, and estimated reading time.
- **Use Cases**: Writers, students, social media content creators, essay writers.

---

MasterTools exposes an Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) catalog at:
